package notsentinel

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
	"example.test/store"
)

// errLast is spelled like a sentinel, but nothing makes it non-nil.
var errLast error

// errLooked is whatever a lookup answered, which may be nil.
var errLooked = store.Lookup()

func checkedFigures(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) {
	if err := auth.Require(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return []int{1}, nil
}

func figuresUnlessLast(ctx context.Context, last bool) ([]int, error) {
	if last {
		return []int{1}, errLast
	}
	return checkedFigures(ctx)
}

func figuresUnlessLooked(ctx context.Context, looked bool) ([]int, error) {
	if looked {
		return []int{1}, errLooked
	}
	return checkedFigures(ctx)
}

// An Err name of a package nobody declared to hold only errors.
func figuresUnlessGone(ctx context.Context, gone bool) ([]int, error) {
	if gone {
		return []int{1}, store.ErrGone
	}
	return checkedFigures(ctx)
}

type Handlers struct{}

func serve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, out []int, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

func (h Handlers) GetUnlessLast(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	out, err := figuresUnlessLast(r.Context(), r.URL == nil)
	serve(w, r, out, err)
}

func (h Handlers) GetUnlessLooked(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	out, err := figuresUnlessLooked(r.Context(), r.URL == nil)
	serve(w, r, out, err)
}

func (h Handlers) GetUnlessGone(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	out, err := figuresUnlessGone(r.Context(), r.URL == nil)
	serve(w, r, out, err)
}
